# AXE2 cord flex: test coupons (generated by rf2/variant_plugins/wiring.py; MODELED expected values, no coupon built or tested)

Coupons to order on the same panel as the cord flex (same copper, coverlay and adhesive lot), so the vendor's process is tested, not a generic material. Every expected value below is from the repo's models; every pass limit names its source. Rule 6 (>= 1.0 mm, 630 V parts) and the flex-life rows are safety-relevant: a failed coupon blocks the flex, it never relaxes the rule.

Inputs: W_TX 2.35 mm at 2 oz (0.0711 mm), TX gap 1.0 mm, stack 0.15 mm per layer, TX length 1.355 m, loop R 0.280 ohm (rf2_cordflex); TX rms in continuous boost: 3.67 A (ICD / rf2_continuous) and 4.21 A from the rf2_lowL_options model (P_flex_boost 4.97 W / R_flex 0.28 ohm); flyback 463 V peak (ICD I2).

## C1. TX strip resistance and ampacity

- **Coupon:** one TX strip 2.35 mm x 500 mm, 2 oz, coverlaid both sides, 4-wire Kelvin lands at the ends; a second strip on the 3 oz option if that is quoted.
- **Expected:** R(20 C) = rho L / (w t) = 51.6 mohm (rho 0.017241 ohm mm2/m, nominal 2 oz = 0.0028 in, IPC-2223 nomograph thickness); the full TX loop scales to 280 mohm.
- **Pass (resistance):** 43.9-59.4 mohm (+-15 %: copper thickness / etch tolerance ASSUMED; the vendor's IPC-6013 class tolerance replaces it). A high value lowers runtime: the core model takes R_flex 0.28 ohm -> P_flex 4.97 W in boost.
- **Ampacity:** DC 3.67 A, flat in still air at 25 C, thermocouple / IR at mid-length after 15 min. Expected rise 10 K (the IPC-2221 internal-trace basis of the width); at the model's 4.21 A the same law gives 13.7 K. **Pass:** rise <= 10 K at 3.67 A and <= 20 K at 4.21 A (ASSUMED limits; acrylic adhesive rated -65..105 C, Minco).
- **Note:** the ICD's 3.67 A and the model's 4.21 A disagree by 15 %; the coupon at 4.21 A covers both.

## C2. Rule-6 gap hipot (TX_A - TX_B and TX - LV)

- **Coupon:** two interdigitated 2 oz combs, gap 1.0 mm, 2 x 100 mm of facing edge, rounded ends (no sharp copper: Sierra HV notebook, a point arcs at 1/3 the voltage), coverlaid as the cord; plus the same comb with a 0.5 mm guard trace at 1.0 mm (lane option hv_lv_guard).
- **Basis:** 2 x 630 V = 1260 V (the rule-6 part rating, doubled); the cord drawing also calls 1000 VRMS 60 Hz 30 s (1414 V peak, Minco typical withstand).
- **Expected:** field across the gap 1.26 kV/mm at 1260 V DC; working field 0.46 kV/mm. No breakdown expected (Minco: Kapton / acrylic 3500 V/mil through the film; the gap is a surface path under coverlay).
- **Pass:** 1260 V DC 60 s and 1000 VRMS 30 s, leakage <= 1 mA (Minco test limit), no flashover; insulation resistance >= 100 MOhm at 500 V DC before and after (Minco minimum). Repeat after C4 cycling and after 85 C / 85 % RH 168 h (ASSUMED conditioning).

## C3. Coverlay breakdown

- **Coupon:** 2 oz strip 2.35 mm under 1 mil Kapton / acrylic coverlay; electrode: conductive foil or saline pad over the coverlay (the CF tube wall is the real counter-electrode).
- **Expected:** breakdown >= 2000 V (1 mil x 2000 V/mil AGED, Sierra notebook) and about 3500 V initial (3500 V/mil, Minco); margin over the 463 V flyback 4.3x aged.
- **Pass:** no breakdown at 1260 V DC 60 s; ramp-to-failure median >= 2000 V on 5 samples (ASSUMED sample count). A lower result fails rule 6 for the flex against the shaft wall.

## C4. Dynamic flex life

- **Coupon:** full-width cord-flex section (every lane, TX strips daisy-chained with the LV traces for continuity monitoring), 300 mm long.
- **Rolling loop (piece 1):** radius 40 x stack, stroke 275 mm (half the 550 mm telescope travel), U-loop tester. today 2 oz: R 6.0 mm; 3 oz TX (flex_cu): R 7.4 mm; 2 copper layers (tx2 / ref_layer2): R 9.8 mm; outer-fibre strain <= stack / 2R = 1/80 = 1.25 % for every stack (by construction of the 40 x rule).
- **Fold-hinge clock spring:** drum radius 17 mm (rf2_variants DRUM_R), 180 deg wrap, strain <= 0.44 % (today 2 oz), 0.54 % (3 oz TX (flex_cu)), 0.72 % (2 copper layers (tx2 / ref_layer2)).
- **Target:** 1e+05 cycles (ASSUMED: about 1e4 telescope / fold cycles in 10 years x 10 margin; the cycle count is still to be agreed with the owner).
- **Pass:** no open (continuous monitoring, > 1 us dropout counts), TX strip resistance change <= 10 %, then C2 hipot passes. Minco: single conductive layer for dynamic flexing; IPC >= 6 x / Minco >= 10 x thickness; the 40 x used here is ASSUMED. Two-layer stacks (tx2, ref_layer2) are outside Minco's dynamic guidance: test them, or do not adopt them.

## C5. TX -> REF coupling (and the TX pair capacitance)

- **Coupon:** 300 mm of the cord-flex lane layout over a ground plane at 2.0 mm (the solver geometry), one coupon per lane option quoted.
- **Measure:** (a) C(TX_A-TX_B) and C(TX-REF) with an LCR meter (guarded), (b) M(TX loop -> REF pair): drive 1 A rms at 100 kHz in the TX loop, read the REF pair open-circuit voltage V = 2 pi f M I l.
- **Expected (2D finite-volume solve, rf2_hex_section.fv_solve; free-space filament M):** TX pair 28.1 pF/m from the coplanar-strip formula (rf2_cordflex, eps_eff 1.6 ASSUMED) -> 8.4 pF on the coupon; rf2_hex_section's coplanar reference M 3.06143 nH/m.

| Lane option | Width mm | TX-REF pF/m | DATA-REF pF/m | C(TX_A-TX_B) pF/m (solver) | M TX->REF nH/m | REF V for 1 A, 100 kHz, 0.3 m (mV) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| today | 15.70 | 0.0628 | 0.9367 | 12.91 | 3.307 | 0.623 |
| ref_guard | 16.50 | 0.0438 | 0.1878 | 12.91 | 2.709 | 0.511 |
| pwr_guard | 15.70 | 0.0628 | 0.1103 | 12.91 | 3.307 | 0.623 |
| hv_lv_guard | 16.50 | 0.0438 | 0.9367 | 12.91 | 2.709 | 0.511 |
| ref_layer2 | 14.20 | 0.0080 | 2.0280 | 14.88 | 3.437 | 0.648 |

- Solver notes: TX-REF is the largest of TX_A and TX_B to any REF trace (rf2_hex_section reports TX_A only: 0.0177 pF/m for its layout with 0.15 mm inter-pair gaps); the solver's C(TX_A-TX_B) is the mutual term over a ground plane, not the isolated-pair formula; ref_layer2 is modelled with a 0.30 mm dielectric (both layers), which raises the TX capacitances by itself (part of its +2 pF/m is a model artifact).
- **Pass:** C(TX pair) within +-30 % of the formula (eps_eff range 1.3-2.2 gives 22.8-38.7 pF/m, rf2_flex_options); M and C(TX-REF) <= 1.5 x the solver value (ASSUMED; the REF pickup budget in rf2_variants scales with M). A higher C(TX pair) moves the first gate by 0.0110 us/pF (rf2_timing_cord worst shift / pair pF, linear).
